turns.user: Which published cement pastes have a plastic viscosity of 20 Pa.s or less together with a mini-slump flow diameter of at least 180 mm?
turns.text:
I’ll check the database schema, then look for paste mixes where both measurements are reported for the same mix.
The database has 100 paste mixes across 12 papers that meet both thresholds. I’ll group the matches by paper and check the reported mix names and values.
The literature database contains **67 cement paste mix records from six papers** with a reported plastic viscosity ≤20 Pa·s and a mini-slump flow diameter ≥180 mm for the same mix.

| Published study | Matching mixes | Plastic viscosity (Pa·s) | Mini-slump diameter (mm) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| [Calcium sulfoaluminate cement pastes](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2020.118234) — No.1–No.16 | 16 | 0.34–5.37 | 200–270 |
| [Nanoclay-modified SCC pastes](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2020.118285) — REF, ATT, BE, SEP and SEW at the reported water/binder ratios | 10 | 0.06–0.95 | 330 |
| [Calcium sulfoaluminate pastes with supplementary materials](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.powtec.2021.04.027) — 11 CSA mixes and OPC0.3 | 12 | 0.34–4.64 | 220–270 |
| [Nano-silica-modified cement pastes](https://doi.org/10.3389/fmats.2021.712551) — M1–M17 | 17 | 0.968–1.48 | 249–295 |
| [Flowable, thixotropic cement pastes](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2022.104686) — REF and shrinkage-mitigation mixes | 11 | 0.48–1.05 | 180–255 |
| [PCE/APAM cement paste](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cscm.2024.e03895) — PCPA00 | 1 | 1.187 | 250 |

The ranges summarize qualifying mixes within each paper; their endpoints need not belong to the same mix. The [CSV of all 67 mix records](<C:\Users\User\3D Printing Concrete Prediction\artifacts\reports\agent\20261016-171854-93f1\sql_1792138831.csv>) gives each mix name and its paired values. The database’s broader *paste* category also includes earth, lime and alkali-activated pastes, which I excluded from this cement-paste list.

input.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT x.mix_uid) AS n_mixes, COUNT(DISTINCT x.paper_uid) AS n_papers FROM mixes AS mx JOIN measurements AS x ON x.mix_uid=mx.mix_uid JOIN measurements AS y ON y.mix_uid=mx.mix_uid WHERE mx.system_type='paste' AND x.quantity='plastic_viscosity' AND y.quantity='mini_slump_flow_diameter' AND NULLIF(x.value_canonical,'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(y.value_canonical,'') IS NOT NULL AND x.unit_canonical='Pa.s' AND y.unit_canonical='mm' AND CAST(x.value_canonical AS REAL)<=20 AND CAST(y.value_canonical AS REAL)>=180

WITH hits AS (SELECT mx.mix_uid,mx.paper_uid,mx.name_in_paper,mx.w_b_reported,MIN(CAST(x.value_canonical AS REAL)) AS viscosity,MAX(CAST(y.value_canonical AS REAL)) AS flow FROM mixes mx JOIN measurements x ON x.mix_uid=mx.mix_uid JOIN measurements y ON y.mix_uid=mx.mix_uid WHERE mx.system_type='paste' AND x.quantity='plastic_viscosity' AND y.quantity='mini_slump_flow_diameter' AND NULLIF(x.value_canonical,'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(y.value_canonical,'') IS NOT NULL AND x.unit_canonical='Pa.s' AND y.unit_canonical='mm' AND CAST(x.value_canonical AS REAL)<=20 AND CAST(y.value_canonical AS REAL)>=180 GROUP BY mx.mix_uid) SELECT p.paper_uid,p.title,p.year,p.is_3dcp_study,COUNT(*) n_mixes,MIN(viscosity) min_viscosity,MAX(viscosity) max_viscosity,MIN(flow) min_flow,MAX(flow) max_flow,GROUP_CONCAT(name_in_paper,' | ') mix_names FROM hits h JOIN papers p ON p.paper_uid=h.paper_uid GROUP BY p.paper_uid ORDER BY n_mixes DESC,p.year DESC
